name: Computer Modern Roman 10 point parameters (cmr10.mf)
edition: official Computer Modern source file cmr10.mf
statement: The parameter file of Computer Modern Roman 10 point: unit width, heights, depths, stem and hairline breadths, serif and jut sizes. The cited baseline of a generated typeface's parameters.
